title: When Messages Go Wrong: Understanding Communication Faults in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.15459v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) use specialized agents that exchange messages to accomplish complex tasks. Their reliance on networked protocols, remote tools, and model endpoints exposes communication to message loss, delay, and context expiration. Because agents often exchange open-ended natural language, anomalies can alter task-relevant information while leaving messages processable, allowing semantic errors to propagate through subsequent interactions. Systematic studies of faults in inter-agent communication remain limited. This paper presents a large-scale empirical study of how communication faults manifest, propagate, and affect task outcomes in LLM-MAS. We construct a cross-layer taxonomy linking lower-stack disturbances to application-visible faults and develop a fault-injection and tracing pipeline. translated_title: 当消息出错时：理解基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中的通信故障
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）通过专门化的智能体之间交换消息来完成复杂任务。它们对网络协议、远程工具和模型端点的依赖，使通信面临消息丢失、延迟和上下文过期的风险。由于智能体之间通常交换开放式的自然语言，异常可能在保持消息仍可处理的情况下改变与任务相关的信息，从而使语义错误在后续交互中不断传播。目前对智能体间通信故障的系统性研究仍然有限。本文对LLM-MAS中通信故障如何表现、传播以及影响任务结果进行了大规模实证研究。我们构建了一个跨层故障分类体系，将底层技术栈的扰动与应用层可见的故障关联起来，并开发了故障注入与追踪流水线。我们的评估涵盖了超过29,000次执行，涉及100个任务、五个领域、三种工作流拓扑结构以及三种……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次对基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中的通信故障开展大规模实证研究，通过构建跨层故障分类体系和故障注入追踪流水线，在超过29,000次执行中系统揭示了通信故障如何表现、传播并影响任务结果。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale empirical study of communication faults in LLM-based multi-agent systems, introducing a cross-layer fault taxonomy and a fault-injection tracing pipeline to systematically reveal how faults manifest, propagate, and affect task outcomes across more than 29,000 executions.
